regions.region: Fig. 1 at upper right and adjacent stereochemical discussion
regions.finding: NMR shifts, NOE correlations and 3JHH support the source assignment of 4; these data are stereochemical characterization context, not an additional synthesis.
Five transformations were inventoried: 7→8; 8→hydroxycarbamate→9; 8→10; 9→4; and the unresolved Rh(II)-catalyst family 10→4. The 10→4 catalyst/yield pairs are not individually recoverable.
The page reports 11 (77%), 12 (31%) and 13 (23%), cis-to-D relationships for 11/12, and the proposed origin of 13; these mentions were merged into the corresponding detailed experiments on pages 4–5.

regions.finding: Two current experiments are shown: 4→11 with Me2CuLi (77%) and 4→12 plus 13 with vinyl-MgBr/CuI (31% and 23%). Scheme temperatures were retained alongside conflicting prose temperatures.
Diagnostic NOE correlations for 11 and 12 support the relative stereochemical assignments; they are source_context and selectivity evidence, not separate reactions.
Formal Cu insertion through 14 and ligand coupling to 15 is a proposed mechanism with generic R/M, recorded separately from the experiments.
